nodes.name: AI Infrastructure Partnership (AIP)
nodes.monetization: Consortium investment partnership (BlackRock/GIP, Microsoft, MGX; Nvidia and xAI since Mar 2025) mobilizing $30B of equity — up to $100B with debt — to buy and build AI data centers and power; monetizes via infrastructure returns on assets like Aligned Data Centers.

nodes.name: Alibaba Group Holding Limited
nodes.monetization: Sells AI cloud (Qwen model family, GPU/inference services) through Alibaba Cloud, funded by e-commerce cash flows and a RMB 380B+ AI capex program.

nodes.name: Aligned Data Centers
nodes.monetization: Develops and leases hyperscale/AI data-center capacity across the Americas (51 campuses, >6.4GW operational and planned); owned since July 2026 by the AIP/MGX/BlackRock-GIP consortium after a ~$40B acquisition from Macquarie Asset Management.

nodes.name: Alphabet Inc. (Google)
nodes.monetization: Monetizes AI through Search/YouTube ads, Google Cloud (TPUs + Gemini), Gemini subscriptions, and model licensing (Apple ~$1B/yr); vertically integrated on its own TPU silicon.

nodes.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Sells AI compute through AWS (Nvidia GPUs + Trainium custom silicon) against a ~$496B backlog; holds large equity stakes in both Anthropic and OpenAI; spending ~$220B of capex in 2026.

nodes.name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Sells Instinct GPUs, EPYC CPUs, and rack-scale AI systems; anchor OpenAI 6GW deal is paired with a milestone-vested warrant booked as contra-revenue.

nodes.name: Amkor Technology
nodes.monetization: #2 global OSAT; sells packaging/test capacity to AI chip designers and takes TSMC advanced-packaging overflow, including the first US high-volume advanced packaging campus (Peoria, AZ).

nodes.name: Ampere Computing
nodes.monetization: Designs Arm-based server CPUs for cloud and AI compute; wholly owned SoftBank Group subsidiary since November 2025, positioned alongside Arm in SoftBank's AI-compute stack.

nodes.name: Anthropic
nodes.monetization: Sells Claude models via API, enterprise plans, and Claude Code; the fastest revenue scaling ever recorded in enterprise software, funded by Amazon, Google, and record venture rounds.

nodes.name: Anysphere (Cursor)
nodes.monetization: Sells the Cursor AI code editor via individual and enterprise subscriptions; the fastest-growing software company ever measured, now agreed to be acquired by SpaceX/xAI for $60B (pending close).

nodes.name: Apollo Global Management, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Alternative asset manager and private-credit giant; monetizes AI by lending against it — GPU-collateralized SPV debt (xAI), margin lending against OpenAI equity (SoftBank syndicate), and Nvidia's compute-collateralized financing coalition.

nodes.name: Apple Inc.
nodes.monetization: Monetizes AI indirectly — as a device-upgrade and services driver — while paying partners (Google ~$1B/yr for a custom Gemini) rather than building frontier models or hyperscale AI capex.

nodes.name: Applied Digital
nodes.monetization: AI data-center developer/landlord (ex-crypto hosting): builds powered campuses in North Dakota (Polaris Forge) and leases them long-term, anchored by ~$11B/400MW of CoreWeave leases plus a $5B hyperscaler lease.

nodes.name: ASE Technology Holding
nodes.monetization: World's largest OSAT (outsourced assembly & test); sells advanced-packaging and test capacity, including CoWoS-class overflow from TSMC, to AI chip designers.

nodes.name: ASML Holding N.V.
nodes.monetization: Monopoly supplier of EUV lithography — every leading-edge AI chip and next-generation memory requires its machines; also Mistral AI's largest shareholder (~11%).

nodes.name: Bank of America Corporation
nodes.monetization: Lends to and seeks capital-markets mandates from AI issuers; extended OpenAI's first bilateral bank credit line ($520M, Jul 2026) while pursuing IPO advisory roles at OpenAI and Anthropic.

nodes.name: BlackRock, Inc.
nodes.monetization: World's largest asset manager; monetizes AI through infrastructure equity (GIP, AIP, Aligned), hyperscaler SPV structures it leads (Meta El Paso), bond allocations (Hyperion), and Nvidia's customer-financing coalition.

nodes.name: Blackstone Inc.
nodes.monetization: Largest alternative asset manager; monetizes AI as landlord and lender to the buildout — owned data-center platforms (QTS, AirTrunk), project equity (Saline Township), frontier-lab equity (Anthropic), and Nvidia's financing coalition.

nodes.name: Blue Owl Capital Inc.
nodes.monetization: Alternative asset manager (~$319B AUM) earning fees on private credit and net-lease capital deployed into AI data centers; majority owner of Meta's Hyperion JV and a Stargate Abilene JV partner.

nodes.name: Broadcom Inc.
nodes.monetization: Sells custom AI accelerators (XPUs) and AI networking silicon to hyperscalers and labs — OpenAI 10GW and Anthropic 3.5GW TPU deals — plus VMware infrastructure software.

nodes.name: Brookfield Asset Management
nodes.monetization: Global infrastructure and renewables manager; monetizes AI through the power leg of the buildout — co-owner of Westinghouse with an $80B US-government nuclear partnership — plus data-center platforms, frontier-lab equity (Anthropic), and Nvidia's financing coalition.

nodes.name: ByteDance Ltd.
nodes.monetization: Monetizes AI via Doubao (China's #1 chatbot, now adding subscriptions), Seedance media models, AI-driven ad targeting on Douyin/TikTok, and Volcano Engine cloud.

nodes.name: Cerebras Systems
nodes.monetization: Sells wafer-scale AI systems and, increasingly, high-speed inference as a service (tokens/sec as the product); the main non-GPU architecture with real revenue.

nodes.name: Cipher Mining
nodes.monetization: Bitcoin miner converted to AI data-center landlord: long-term hosting leases at its West Texas campuses to AWS (~$5.5B/15yr, 300MW) and Fluidstack (~$3B/10yr at Barber Lake, Google-backstopped; Google ~5.4% pro forma equity).

nodes.name: Cognition AI
nodes.monetization: Sells Devin, an autonomous AI software engineer, plus the Windsurf IDE — priced per-agent/per-seat to enterprises replacing or augmenting engineering capacity.

nodes.name: Coherent Corp.
nodes.monetization: Sells 800G/1.6T datacom transceivers, lasers (EML/VCSEL), and optical components into AI back-end networks; Nvidia investee.

nodes.name: Comfort Systems USA, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Installs the mechanical and electrical guts of data centers — HVAC, piping, modular builds, electrical — with technology customers now ~58% of revenue and a record $14.1B backlog.

nodes.name: Constellation Energy Corporation
nodes.monetization: Sells firm carbon-free nuclear power to hyperscalers under 15–20-year PPAs — Microsoft (Crane/TMI restart), Meta (Clinton) — on top of the largest US nuclear fleet, expanded by Calpine's gas fleet.

nodes.name: CoreWeave, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Rents Nvidia GPU capacity under multi-year take-or-pay contracts to Microsoft, OpenAI, and Meta; funds the fleet with ~$35B of largely GPU-collateralized debt.

nodes.name: Crusoe Energy Systems (Crusoe AI)
nodes.monetization: Designs, builds, and operates energy-first AI datacenter campuses (builder of Stargate Abilene) and sells GPU cloud capacity; monetizes power access as the scarce input.

nodes.name: Databricks
nodes.monetization: Sells consumption-based data + AI platform services (lakehouse, warehousing, agents, serverless Postgres); AI products alone crossed $1B annualized.

nodes.name: DeepSeek (Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co.)
nodes.monetization: Open-weight frontier models (V-series, R-series) monetized through ultra-cheap API pricing; historically bankrolled by founder Liang Wenfeng's High-Flyer hedge fund rather than outside capital.

nodes.name: Dell Technologies Inc.
nodes.monetization: Builds and sells AI servers (ISG) to neoclouds, labs, and enterprises — $51.3B AI backlog and a ~$60B FY27 AI revenue guide — with storage, networking, and services attach.

nodes.name: The Walt Disney Company
nodes.monetization: Media and IP owner; its AI exposure is as a licensor of characters/IP to generative-AI platforms — an announced $1B OpenAI equity-plus-IP-license deal (Dec 2025) was withdrawn in Mar 2026 with $0 delivered.

nodes.name: Dominion Energy
nodes.monetization: Regulated utility serving Northern Virginia — the world's largest data-center cluster; monetizes AI via rate-based transmission/substation buildout for ~40GW of contracted DC demand.

nodes.name: Eaton Corporation plc
nodes.monetization: Sells electrical power management from grid to chip — switchgear, UPS, busway, and (post-Boyd) liquid cooling — with data centers now its largest end-market.

nodes.name: EMCOR Group
nodes.monetization: Sells mechanical/electrical construction and facilities services; data-center electrical fit-out is the fastest-growing book of business.

nodes.name: Entergy Corporation
nodes.monetization: Regulated Gulf-South utility; monetizes AI through rate-based new gas generation and transmission serving Meta's Hyperion campus in Richland Parish, Louisiana (~2.2GW load) under long-term electric service agreements.

nodes.name: Fluidstack
nodes.monetization: Assembles GPU capacity by leasing miner-owned datacenters (TeraWulf, Cipher, Hut 8) — with Google backstopping the leases — and delivers it to frontier labs, above all Anthropic.

nodes.name: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd. (Foxconn)
nodes.monetization: World's largest AI-server assembler — builds Nvidia rack systems and Stargate/US AI-infrastructure hardware; cloud & networking passed 51% of revenue in Q2 2026.

nodes.name: G42
nodes.monetization: Abu Dhabi AI holding group (Core42 cloud, Khazna data centers, Inception models); monetizes by operating UAE sovereign AI infrastructure — including Stargate UAE — and reselling compute, backed by Microsoft's $1.5B strategic stake.

nodes.name: Galaxy Digital
nodes.monetization: Crypto financial-services firm turned AI data-center landlord: converted its Helios (West Texas) bitcoin-mining campus into 526MW of CoreWeave-leased AI capacity (>$30B potential 25-yr value), funded partly with $3.5B of high-yield bonds.

nodes.name: GE Vernova Inc.
nodes.monetization: Sells gas turbines, grid equipment, and multi-decade service agreements into the power buildout that AI data-center load is driving; sells out capacity years ahead via paid slot reservations.

nodes.name: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Investment bank; monetizes AI via lending and underwriting fees — SoftBank's OpenAI-collateralized loans, the $38B Vantage/Oracle project package, advisory on mega-financings (Saline Township), and structuring for Nvidia's >$500B customer-financing coalition.

nodes.name: Groq, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Designs LPU inference accelerators and sells inference tokens-as-a-service via GroqCloud; monetized its core IP via a ~$20B non-exclusive technology license to NVIDIA (announced late Dec 2025), after which the cloud business continues independently.

nodes.name: HD Hyundai Electric
nodes.monetization: Sells power transformers and switchgear, with record US orders driven by data-center and grid demand; production booked out more than three years.

nodes.name: Hitachi Energy
nodes.monetization: Sells transformers, HVDC, and grid equipment into utility and data-center buildouts; world's largest transformer maker (Hitachi Ltd. subsidiary, HQ Zurich).

nodes.name: Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.
nodes.monetization: Sells the domestic full stack — Ascend accelerators (with in-house HBM), Atlas SuperPoDs, Kunpeng CPUs, MindSpore/CANN software, and Huawei Cloud — as China's sanctioned-market Nvidia substitute.

nodes.name: Humain
nodes.monetization: Saudi PIF-owned full-stack AI company; monetizes by selling sovereign AI compute (GPU data centers, cloud) and Arabic-first models, anchored by state capital and partner offtake (xAI as first customer of its flagship DC).

nodes.name: Hyperion JV (Meta / Blue Owl — Beignet Investor LLC)
nodes.monetization: Bankruptcy-remote joint venture that owns Meta's Hyperion data-center campus in Richland Parish, Louisiana; monetizes via Meta's lease payments, which service $27.3B of amortizing A+ notes — Meta's largest capex project, moved off its balance sheet.

nodes.name: Ibiden Co., Ltd.
nodes.monetization: Sells ABF package substrates for high-end logic; Nvidia's lead substrate supplier, with AI-substrate capacity effectively sold out as it is added.

nodes.name: Informatica
nodes.monetization: Enterprise data-management/integration platform (IDMC); acquired by Salesforce for ~$8B to supply the data foundation for Agentforce agentic AI.

nodes.name: Intel Corporation
nodes.monetization: Sells x86 CPUs (data center + client) while rebuilding as a US-champion foundry — recapitalized by the US government (~10%), Nvidia ($5B), SoftBank ($2B), and a $15B public share sale.

nodes.name: Intersect Power
nodes.monetization: Clean-energy IPP building co-located power + data-center 'energy parks'; monetizes via power sales and site development under a $20B program with Google and TPG Rise Climate.

nodes.name: Intuit Inc.
nodes.monetization: Sells TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp; pays OpenAI >$100M multi-year for model access and distribution of its apps inside ChatGPT.

nodes.name: io Products, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Pre-revenue AI hardware-device startup founded by Jony Ive and LoveFrom alumni; acquired by OpenAI for ~$6.5B in stock (2025) to build OpenAI's consumer AI devices.

nodes.name: IREN Limited
nodes.monetization: Bitcoin miner turned vertically-integrated AI cloud: owns power-rich sites (Childress TX, 750MW) and sells GPU-cloud capacity, anchored by a $9.7B/5-year Microsoft contract on NVIDIA GB300s.

nodes.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
nodes.monetization: Largest US bank; monetizes AI as lead arranger of data-center project debt (Vantage $38B, Stargate Abilene construction loans) and margin/bridge lending against AI equity stakes (SoftBank) — while its research sizes the AI debt market it is building.

nodes.name: Kairos Power
nodes.monetization: SMR developer (fluoride-salt-cooled high-temperature reactors); pre-revenue on power sales, monetizing via the Google master agreement to deliver 500MW of reactors by 2035 plus DOE/TVA demonstration support.

nodes.name: KKR & Co. Inc.
nodes.monetization: Private-equity and infrastructure manager; monetizes AI through data-center platform ownership (CyrusOne, Nxera/STT GDC in APAC) and, via Nvidia's coalition, compute-collateralized customer financing.

nodes.name: Lambda (Lambda Labs)
nodes.monetization: Rents Nvidia GPU cloud capacity ('superintelligence cloud') to AI labs and enterprises; anchored by a multibillion-dollar Microsoft deal; IPO planned.

nodes.name: Lumentum Holdings
nodes.monetization: Sells datacom lasers and 800G/1.6T transceivers for AI clusters; record 800G shipments with 1.6T ramping; Nvidia investee.

nodes.name: Meta El Paso SPV (Project Sopaipilla Holdings)
nodes.monetization: Special-purpose venture that develops and owns Meta's 1GW El Paso, TX data-center campus; ~80% owned by funds managed by BlackRock (GIP and HPS), 20% by Meta; income is Meta's lease payments as sole occupant.

nodes.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Monetizes AI through ad targeting/ranking and engagement across Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp; no cloud business — AI is a cost center funded by ads, bonds, and off-balance-sheet SPVs.

nodes.name: MGX
nodes.monetization: Abu Dhabi state-backed AI investor (Mubadala/G42-anchored, chaired by Sheikh Tahnoun bin Zayed); monetizes AI via a $49B dedicated fund spanning frontier-lab equity (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI), Stargate, and data-center platforms (AIP, Aligned).

nodes.name: Micron Technology, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Sells DRAM, HBM, and NAND — the US-based HBM supplier, with capacity sold out and revenue up ~4.5× y/y at super-cycle pricing.

nodes.name: Microsoft Corporation
nodes.monetization: Sells AI via Azure cloud consumption and Copilot seats across Microsoft 365/GitHub/Dynamics; holds ~27% of OpenAI plus a capped 20% revenue share; funds it with ~$190B/yr of capex.

nodes.name: Mistral AI
nodes.monetization: Sells frontier and open-weight models to European enterprises and governments (Le Chat, La Plateforme, on-prem deployments); Europe's sovereignty premium is the business model.

nodes.name: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries
nodes.monetization: One of three global heavy-duty gas-turbine makers; sells turbines and long-term service into US/Asian data-center power demand.

nodes.name: Morgan Stanley
nodes.monetization: Investment bank; monetizes AI as the structurer of record for AI credit — arranged Meta's $27.3B Hyperion SPV notes and xAI's $5B secured notes/term loans — while its research benchmarks the cycle (~$570B 2026 AI-debt-issuance forecast).

nodes.name: Nebius Group N.V.
nodes.monetization: Rents Nvidia GPU cloud capacity under multi-year contracts — ~$46B contracted with Microsoft and Meta — while scaling capex far ahead of current revenue.

nodes.name: NextEra Energy
nodes.monetization: Largest US renewables developer plus regulated Florida utility (FPL); monetizes AI demand through long-term PPAs with hyperscalers, headlined by the 25-year Duane Arnold nuclear restart deal with Google.

nodes.name: Nokia Oyj
nodes.monetization: Sells mobile (RAN), fixed, optical, and data-center networking equipment; AI exposure via AI-RAN co-development with NVIDIA (its 2.9% shareholder) and data-center optical networking (Infinera acquisition).

nodes.name: Nscale
nodes.monetization: Builds and rents sovereign-flavored GPU capacity across the UK, Norway, Portugal, and Texas — ~$20B+ of Microsoft contracts (~200K GB300s) — targeting a 2026 IPO.

nodes.name: Nvidia Customer-Financing Coalition
nodes.monetization: Announced framework (Aug 10, 2026) under which Nvidia and six financial giants would provide >$500B of financing for Nvidia customers' compute purchases through compute-collateralized SPV structures; would monetize via financing spreads on GPU-backed paper — nothing funded yet.

nodes.name: NVIDIA Corporation
nodes.monetization: Sells AI accelerators, systems, and networking; increasingly also an investor in and financier of its own customer base.

nodes.name: Oklo Inc.
nodes.monetization: Pre-revenue SMR developer selling power (not reactors) under long-term agreements; data-center operators are the anchor customer class.

nodes.name: OpenAI
nodes.monetization: Sells ChatGPT subscriptions, API access, and enterprise AI; deeply loss-making at scale and funded by the largest private capital raises in history.

nodes.name: Oracle Corporation
nodes.monetization: Sells OCI cloud infrastructure against a $638B contracted backlog dominated by OpenAI/Stargate, funded by aggressive debt issuance — the ecosystem's key credit-watch entity.

nodes.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
nodes.monetization: Sells its AI Platform (AIP) and ontology software to enterprises and governments at premium prices — the fastest-growing large software company of the AI cycle, and its most-watched valuation battleground.

nodes.name: Perplexity AI
nodes.monetization: Sells Pro/Max subscriptions to an AI answer engine and the Comet browser; building toward commerce and OEM distribution revenue while sharing revenue with publishers.

nodes.name: PIMCO (Pacific Investment Management Company)
nodes.monetization: The world's largest active fixed-income manager (Allianz-owned); monetizes AI as the anchor buyer of the biggest investment-grade AI data-center bonds (Hyperion ~$18B; Saline Township ~$10B).

nodes.name: Quanta Services, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Builds and electrifies the grid and data centers with the largest skilled electrical-labor force in North America — transmission, substations, and DC electrical fit-out (Cupertino Electric).

nodes.name: Riot Platforms
nodes.monetization: Bitcoin miner converting its Rockdale, TX campus to AI hosting: 20-year leases to AMD (Jan 2026) and a ~$9.1B lease to a frontier AI lab reported to be Anthropic (Aug 2026), totaling ~241MW / ~$9.8B contracted.

nodes.name: Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI)
nodes.monetization: None — $0 revenue by design; a research-only bet on building safe superintelligence 'in a straight shot', monetization explicitly deferred.

nodes.name: Salesforce, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Sells AI agents (Agentforce) and data infrastructure (Data 360/Informatica) as paid add-ons to the world's largest CRM installed base; buys model capability from Anthropic and others rather than training its own.

nodes.name: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.
nodes.monetization: Sells HBM4/server DRAM/NAND into the AI memory super-cycle, runs a contract foundry (Tesla AI6, $16.5B), and co-anchors OpenAI's Stargate memory supply.

nodes.name: Scale AI
nodes.monetization: Sells training data — labeling, RLHF, and expert data pipelines — plus government AI services; now effectively a Meta-aligned data arm after the 2025 quasi-acquisition.

nodes.name: Schneider Electric SE
nodes.monetization: Sells electrical distribution, secure power (APC UPS), cooling (Motivair), and EcoStruxure software into data centers — the group's largest growth driver at roughly a quarter of revenue.

nodes.name: ServiceNow, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Sells AI (Now Assist / agentic workflows) as premium-priced SKUs on its enterprise workflow platform; AI annual contract value crossed $1B in Q2 2026.

nodes.name: Siemens Energy AG
nodes.monetization: Sells gas turbines, grid technologies (transformers, HVDC, switchgear), and long-term service into AI-driven power demand; order book stretches to four-year delivery waits.

nodes.name: SK hynix Inc.
nodes.monetization: Sells HBM and server DRAM/NAND into the AI buildout — ~60% HBM share, lead HBM4 supplier to Nvidia, multi-year supply agreements with ~10 customers.

nodes.name: Snowflake Inc.
nodes.monetization: Sells the AI Data Cloud; monetizes AI via Cortex AI consumption, paying OpenAI and Anthropic ($200M multi-year each) for frontier-model access it resells to 12,600+ enterprise customers.

nodes.name: SoftBank Group Corp.
nodes.monetization: Investment holding company whose AI monetization is portfolio appreciation: ~13% of OpenAI (planned), ~90% of Arm, ~40% of Stargate, Ampere — increasingly funded by asset sales and debt secured against those same stakes.

nodes.name: Solaris Energy Infrastructure
nodes.monetization: Mobile gas-turbine power-as-a-service provider; monetizes AI through the 50.1%-owned Stateline Power JV with xAI (49.9%) supplying behind-the-meter turbine power to the Memphis-area Colossus data-center cluster.

nodes.name: Stargate Abilene JV (Crusoe / Blue Owl / Primary Digital Infrastructure)
nodes.monetization: The $15B joint venture that owns and is building the 1.2GW flagship Stargate campus in Abilene, TX; income is lease payments from Oracle, which operates the site for OpenAI workloads.

nodes.name: Stargate LLC
nodes.monetization: Joint venture that raises and deploys capital to build OpenAI-dedicated AI data centers in the US; economics flow from OpenAI's long-term compute offtake at JV-financed sites — a capital-projects vehicle, not an operating-revenue business.

nodes.name: Super Micro Computer
nodes.monetization: Builds AI server racks (NVIDIA GB200/GB300 NVL72, liquid-cooled) for hyperscalers, neoclouds, and labs; built much of xAI's Colossus and supplies GB300 racks for Colossus 2.

nodes.name: Talen Energy Corporation
nodes.monetization: Sells nuclear power from Susquehanna to Amazon under the AI era's only disclosed-price nuclear PPA: ~$18B of expected revenue over 17 years for up to 1,920MW.

nodes.name: Tata Group
nodes.monetization: Indian conglomerate (Tata Sons holding; TCS listed) whose TCS HyperVault unit sells AI-ready data-center capacity — OpenAI is the anchor customer, starting at 100MW with ambitions toward 1GW.

nodes.name: Tencent Holdings Limited
nodes.monetization: Monetizes AI through advertising uplift, games, and Hunyuan-powered cloud/agents, funding a ~3× y/y AI capex ramp from platform cash flows.

nodes.name: TeraWulf Inc.
nodes.monetization: Bitcoin miner converted to AI data-center landlord: leases purpose-built HPC capacity at Lake Mariner (NY) to Fluidstack under long-term, Google-backstopped leases (Google ~14% pro forma equity holder).

nodes.name: Tesla, Inc.
nodes.monetization: Sells EVs, energy storage, and robotics; monetizes AI through FSD/robotaxi software and designs in-house AI inference silicon (AI5/AI6), fabbed externally — including a $16.5B AI6 foundry deal with Samsung's Taylor, TX fab through 2033.

nodes.name: Tokyo Electron
nodes.monetization: Sells wafer-fab equipment (coater/developers, etch, deposition); near-monopoly in EUV coater/developer tracks paired with ASML scanners; AI-related demand ~40% of sales.

nodes.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company
nodes.monetization: Manufactures nearly all leading-edge AI silicon (Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom XPUs, Apple) and owns the CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity that paces the entire buildout.

nodes.name: United States Government (federal AI-related programs)
nodes.monetization: Not a profit-seeker by charter, but now a direct financial participant in the AI economy: ~10% equity in Intel, a 15% cut of Nvidia/AMD China chip revenue, profit participation in the Westinghouse nuclear buildout, and $1-a-year AI procurement that shapes lab revenue quality.

nodes.name: Valor Equity Partners
nodes.monetization: Growth-stage private equity firm (Chicago); long-time backer of Musk companies (Tesla, SpaceX, xAI); earns management fees and carry, increasingly on AI-infrastructure structured vehicles.

nodes.name: Vantage Data Centers
nodes.monetization: Develops and leases hyperscale datacenter campuses — flagship: the $25B/1.4GW Frontier campus for Oracle/OpenAI's Stargate — funded by sponsor equity and ~$38B of bank project debt.

nodes.name: Vertiv Holdings Co
nodes.monetization: Sells the power and cooling guts of AI data centers — UPS, switchgear, busway, liquid-cooling CDUs, racks, and services — to hyperscalers, neoclouds, and colocation operators.

nodes.name: Vistra Corp.
nodes.monetization: Sells nuclear and gas power to hyperscalers under 20-year PPAs — >2,600MW to Meta across its PJM nuclear fleet, up to 1,200MW of Comanche Peak to Amazon — while buying gas fleets to serve data-center load.

nodes.name: Waymo
nodes.monetization: Sells autonomous ride-hailing (per-trip robotaxi fares) in a growing set of US cities; the first embodied-AI business generating consumer revenue at scale.

nodes.name: Westinghouse Electric Company
nodes.monetization: Sells AP1000/AP300 reactors, nuclear fuel, and services; owned by Brookfield (51%) and Cameco (49%); anchor of the $80B US-government new-build program.

nodes.name: Wiz
nodes.monetization: Cloud-security platform (CNAPP); acquired by Alphabet for $32B all-cash — Google's largest acquisition ever — to anchor Google Cloud's security offering in the AI buildout.

nodes.name: xAI GPU SPV (Colossus 2 chip-leasing vehicle)
nodes.monetization: Special-purpose vehicle that buys Nvidia GPUs and leases them to xAI over five years; monetizes via lease payments, keeping ~$20B of compute financing — and the hardware — off xAI's balance sheet.

nodes.name: SpaceX / xAI (merged)
nodes.monetization: Grok subscriptions/API and X platform integration inside SpaceX's launch/Starlink cash-flow machine; monetizes the merger thesis that space and AI compute converge.

nodes.name: ZT Systems
nodes.monetization: Hyperscale AI server and rack-level systems designer; acquired by AMD for $4.9B (closed Mar 2025) for its systems-design talent, with the manufacturing business resold to Sanmina for ~$3B.
